more_cobblemon_tweaks.config.option.open: Should the PC remember and open to the last box you had open?
more_cobblemon_tweaks.config.option.pc_i: Adds a small widget to the pc menu showing the iv's of the previewed pokemon.
more_cobblemon_tweaks.config.option.pc_c: If enabled, the IVs in the iv display will be colored matching their respective power items.
Colored IVs requires IV Display to be enabled!
more_cobblemon_tweaks.config.option.pc_m: If enabled, adds a button to the PC to allow selecting multiple pokemon at once for moving or releasing.
more_cobblemon_tweaks.config.option.enha: Adds lore describing various information about the pokemon contained in an egg.
more_cobblemon_tweaks.config.option.bypa: If Enhanced Egg Lore is enabled, and an egg's encrypted, should MoreCobblemonTweaks try to bypass the encryption?
more_cobblemon_tweaks.config.option.shin: If Enhanced Egg Lore is enabled, should it display if an egg is shiny with a gold star?
Shiny Egg Indicator requires Enhanced Egg Lore to be enabled!
more_cobblemon_tweaks.config.option.perf: If Enhanced Egg Lore is enabled, should it display if an egg has perfect IVs with a gold triangle?
Perfect IV Egg Indicator requires Enhanced Egg Lore to be enabled!
more_cobblemon_tweaks.config.option.wait: Waiting on cobblemon egg side-mods to update to 1.7.1!
